svg.title: hypeForge
svg.desc: The KognogOS desktop on Sway: windows tile by themselves, terminal apps first, every setting a Forge app. A small drawing shows a screen with the hypeForge bar on top and three windows side by side: a terminal, displayForge and a file list.
svg.text: The KognogOS desktop on Sway, light and quick
